rows.text: 节温器根据温度自动调节流向散热器的冷却液，而不是通过仪表板开关操作。
evidence: https://www.valeoservice.co.uk/en-uk/lcv/cooling-and-air-management-lcv/thermostats — apertura alla temperatura prevista e flusso al radiatore.

rows.text: 轮胎与路面的接地区域产生转向、加速和制动所需的力。
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: 轮胎通过变形缓冲路面不平，与悬架共同起到减振作用。
evidence: https://thetiredigest.michelin.com/performance-noise-and-comfort — pneumatico flessibile attenua gli urti delle irregolarità.

rows.text: 驱动力通过轮胎接地印迹传到路面；超过可用附着力时车轮会打滑。
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: 制动力通过轮胎接地印迹传到路面，受可用附着力限制。
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: 试题标为 VERO：轮胎通过可变形的接地印迹承载重量，使接触分布在路面上。这可以减少载荷集中，但不能保证路面不受损；重载仍会造成磨损。
evidence: https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policy/otps/truck/wusr/chap04.cfm — FHWA: l’interazione pneumatico-carico incide sul deterioramento del manto.

https://cdn.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — Continental p.7 PDF locale visualizzato: impronta e sostegno del carico; distribuzione del contatto è inferenza fisica.

rows.text: 接地印迹产生的侧向力使车辆沿所需方向行驶，但不能超过可用附着力。
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: 胎面沟槽收集并排走接地印迹中的水，有助于保持与湿路面的接触。
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/auto/en/advice/change-tyres/how-long-do-tyres-last — il battistrada raccoglie e scarica acqua.

rows.text: 轮胎必须能够变形：其弹性有助于吸收路面不平并保持接触。
evidence: https://thetiredigest.michelin.com/performance-noise-and-comfort — deformazione, aderenza e attenuazione degli urti.

rows.text: 出发前不必预热轮胎。应按车辆说明在冷胎状态下检查胎压。
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — controllo della pressione a pneumatici freddi secondo la prescrizione del veicolo.

rows.text: 胎压警告灯提示压力不足，并不表示轮胎必须更换。磨损和损伤应直接检查。
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — TPMS rileva pressione bassa; controllare usura e danni.

rows.text: 换用更软的胶料不要求调硬减振器。替换轮胎必须符合车辆规格。
evidence: https://africa.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/choose-tyres/choose-tyres-for-my-car — scelta secondo dimensioni e specifiche del veicolo; nessuna regolazione degli ammortizzatori prescritta.

rows.text: 磨损会使沟槽变浅，可能降低湿地附着力，增加水滑风险。
evidence: https://africa.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/change-tyres/tyre-wear-indicator — battistrada poco profondo e perdita di aderenza sul bagnato.

rows.text: 所述坡度本身并不要求使用加强型轮胎：应按照车辆规格及所需承载能力选择轮胎。
evidence: Continental Truck, Bus & Trailer Tire Product Data Guide 2025, https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/us/truck/literature/catalogs/TT-CO-BK-DATA.pdf — tire selection matched to axle loads and load/inflation tables; supports necessary load capacity, not proof that no special operating rule could exist.

rows.text: 适合车辆且经过认证的翻新轮胎也可在高速公路上使用；翻新本身不构成普遍禁令。
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A42026X0308 — regolamento ONU 109, omologazione pneumatici ricostruiti per veicoli commerciali.
https://www.continental-tires.com/us/en/about-us/newsroom/truck-and-bus/contitread-hdl-5-ep/ — esempio di ricostruito progettato per lunghe percorrenze autostradali.

rows.text: 在盘式车轮中，轮盘将车轮连接至轮毂，轮辋支撑轮胎。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, ruota a disco composta da cerchio e disco.

rows.text: 轮辋代号标明其尺寸和结构特征，有助于选择匹配的轮胎。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, esempio di designazione e compatibilità.

rows.text: 轮辋代号中的宽度是两个轮缘之间的距离，不是轮胎宽度。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, larghezza nella designazione del cerchio.

rows.text: 代号中的字母，例如 J，表示轮辋轮缘的轮廓类型。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, J indica il tipo di balconata.

rows.text: 轮辋代号包括安装轮胎胎圈处的公称直径；两者的直径必须匹配。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, diametro del cerchio e necessaria corrispondenza con pneumatico.

rows.text: ET 标记表示偏距，即轮辋中心平面与轮盘在轮毂上的安装面之间的距离。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, ET e definizione di offset.

rows.text: 轮胎侧壁的日期代码表示生产周次和年份，不是到期日期。
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/calendarwk23070 — codice TIN indica settimana e anno.

rows.text: 轮辋代号描述的是轮辋。轮胎侧壁的日期代码表示生产周次和年份，而非确切日期。
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/calendarwk23070 — codice sullo pneumatico indica settimana e anno.
https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, marcatura del cerchio.

rows.text: 轮辋代号标识轮辋特征，不表示轮胎的检查日期；应定期检查磨损和损伤。
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, dati identificativi del cerchio.
https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — ispezioni periodiche per usura e danni.

rows.text: 轮辋代号描述轮辋特征，不表示轮胎的到期年份。侧壁代码表示生产时间。
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — TIN sul fianco indica settimana e anno di fabbricazione.
https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, designazione del cerchio.

source_inspection.source: Continental 2025 Truck, Bus & Trailer Tire Product Data Guide
source_inspection.finding: Inspected full 120-page PDF locally; printed p.96 (PDF p.97) tabulates tyre load limits by cold inflation pressure, size and single/dual fitment. Supports load-capacity selection; does not establish absence of every possible special rule.

issues.reason: Il quesito stampa VERO per l’affermazione che lo pneumatico evita che il peso del veicolo danneggi il manto stradale, senza condizioni. La fonte tecnica indica invece che carichi su ruote e assi possono causare danni alla pavimentazione. Non è chiarito se il quesito intenda soltanto una riduzione del contatto diretto o dei danni superficiali: tale portata non è espressa nel testo.
checked_sources: Quiz ufficiale superiori, PDF SHA-256 a8bb47ac18788c151ba4596b4095221a4a2fce6f2cb026ffe671cf8283df9234, pagina 123 (indice 122), n. 29941: affermazione e risposta VERO stampata.
https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/infrastructure/pavements/13038/007.cfm — sezione Traffic Loads: i carichi delle ruote e degli assi possono danneggiare la pavimentazione.
https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policy/otps/truck/wusr/chap04.cfm — Truck-Pavement Interaction: il deterioramento dipende dai carichi sugli assi e anche dal numero e dalla larghezza degli pneumatici.
